name: CI warm cache stale — poweredge-xubuntu uv generation older than 60 min
description: Fires when MAX(livespec.ci_cache.generation_age_s) for tier=uv, host.name=poweredge-xubuntu, over the trailing 10 min exceeds 3600 s — twice the populator's 30-minute schedule, so the warm-cache-populate CronJob (ns ci-warm-cache) has missed at least two ticks: it is gone from the tmpfs datastore after a boot the converge did not finish, it is failing before publish, or it is stuck (concurrencyPolicy Forbid behind a hung run). Every job still runs, cold-ish, against an aging lower; the crates proxy and sccache keep serving. Value trigger; silence is the cache dead-man's job. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; sudo kubectl -n ci-warm-cache get cronjob,jobs; sudo kubectl -n ci-warm-cache logs job/<latest>; sudo ls -la /var/lib/rancher/k3s/storage/.warm. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-cache-gauges.sh (mtime of the warm/uv symlink target). livespec-dev-tooling-gjqw2i, plan ci-runner-cache-tiers research/003 §Triggers.
